## 🗺️ AI + Strukturierte Daten – Node-Übersicht
| 4 Nodes | Kategorie: AI Agents |

---

**Was passiert hier?**
Ein RSS-Feed wird abgerufen, bereinigt, von einem LLM analysiert –
und das Ergebnis landet als sauberes JSON in Google Sheets.

---

- **🌐 HTTP Request** – Ruft den RSS-Feed als XML-Rohtext ab. Ohne Custom `User-Agent`-Header blockiert der Server die Anfrage.
- **⚙️ Code** – Bereinigt den XML-Rohtext: entfernt Metadaten, normalisiert HTML-Entities, gibt lesbaren Plaintext zurück.
- **🔗 Basic LLM Chain** – Schickt den bereinigten Feed mit Prompt ans Modell. Der Output Parser ist direkt angebunden – kein Freitext, sondern valides JSON.
- **🤖 Google Gemini Chat Model** – Das angebundene Sprachmodell. Austauschbar gegen andere Modelle ohne den Rest des Workflows zu ändern.
- **📐 Structured Output Parser** – Definiert das JSON-Schema für die LLM-Antwort. Garantiert eine einheitliche, weiterverarbeitbare Struktur.

parameters.text:
=You are a professional AI and technology news analyst.

Task:
Analyze the following list of news items and identify the most important AI-related technology and IT news.

Focus exclusively on:
- Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, and Generative AI
- New or upcoming AI models, platforms, or systems
- New AI tools, products, or developer platforms
- Significant AI technology trends or industry shifts
- Major technical breakthroughs in AI with real-world impact

Explicitly exclude:
- Non-AI political or general technology news
- Business or company news without a clear AI technology focus
- Opinion pieces, speculation, or hype without concrete announcements
- Duplicate or very similar stories

Selection criteria:
- High relevance for the AI, technology, or IT community
- Clear technological innovation or capability change
- Practical or strategic impact (developers, enterprises, products)
- Current and time-sensitive topics

Instructions:
- Select a maximum of 5 top AI technology news stories.
- Base your selection only on the provided content.
- Do not invent or assume information not present in the text.

For each selected news story, provide:
- title: a short, clear headline
- summary: 1–2 concise sentences describing the core AI-related development
- category: one of the following (choose the best match)
  - AI Model & Platform Launch
  - AI Tools & Products
  - AI Industry Trends
  - AI Research & Breakthroughs
  - Other

Input news items:
{{ $json.data }}

function cleanRSSFeed(xmlString) {
  return xmlString
    .replace(/<\?xml[^>]*\?>/g, '')
    .replace(/<channel>/, '')
    .replace(/<\/channel>/, '')
    .replace(/<title>AI Weekly[^<]*<\/title>/, '')
    .replace(/<link>https:\/\/aiweekly[^<]*<\/link>/, '')
    .replace(/<description>The leading[^<]*<\/description>/, '')
    .replace(/<language>[^<]*<\/language>/g, '')
    .replace(/<atom:link[^/]*\/>/g, '')
    .replace(/<lastBuildDate>[^<]*<\/lastBuildDate>/g, '')
    .replace(/<rss[^>]*>/g, '')
    .replace(/<\/rss>/g, '')
    .replace(/<guid[^>]*>.*?<\/guid>/gs, '')
    .replace(/<link>.*?<\/link>/gs, '')
    .replace(/<\/?item>/g, '')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/->/g, '→')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();
}

const cleaned = cleanRSSFeed($input.first().json.data);

return [{ json: { cleaned } }];
